name: Berserk
description: Berserk is a dark fantasy epic following Guts, a lone mercenary marked for death, who battles demonic Apostles and his former friend, Griffith, who sacrificed their comrades to become a God Hand demon

name: Witch Hat Atelier
description: Witch Hat Atelier is a fantasy manga following Coco, a young girl who discovers that magic is drawn rather than born, following a forbidden magic spell accident that turns her mother to stone. She is taken as an apprentice by the witch Qifrey, learning to use drawing-based magic to solve mysteries, face dangerous "Brimmed Caps," and find a way to save her mother.

name: More than Lovers less than Friends
description: Ex-AV star Miyako unexpectedly runs into a former coworker at a marriage interview...?! The secretly connected pair are bursting with more pure energy than you can imagine! This cute adult love comedy hits different and will heal your soul.

name: Whisper Me a Love Song
description: Manga following Himari Kino, who falls in love at first sight with Yori Asanagi after hearing her band perform. Yori immediately falls for Himari, but the plot hinges on them realizing they define love differently

name: Tales of Demons and Gods
description: Popular Chinese manhua (manga) about Nie Li, the strongest Demon Spiritualist, who dies fighting the Sage Emperor and is reborn as his 13-year-old self. Using his past-life knowledge, he vows to protect Glory City, strengthen his friends, and destroy the villains who destroyed his home.

name: Ancient Magus Bride
description: A dark fantasy manga following Chise Hatori, a depressed, orphaned Japanese girl with supernatural sight who sells herself into slavery. She is bought by Elias Ainsworth, a powerful non-human mage, who intends to make her his apprentice and his bride, introducing her to a magical, often dangerous, British fae world.

name: Goblin Slayer
description: Is a dark fantasy manga following an obsessive, silver-ranked adventurer dedicated solely to eradicating goblins after they destroyed his village and killed his sister. He rescues a young Priestess, forming a party with her, an High Elf, Dwarf, and Lizardman, gradually warming up while taking on brutal, low-level goblin quests.

name: Record of Ragnarok
description: Is a manga series where 13 gods fight 13 human champions in 1-on-1 arena battles to determine humanity's survival. When gods vote to destroy humanity, the Valkyrie Brunhilde challenges them to Ragnarok, a final tournament, aiming to save mankind from total annihilation.

name: Mieruko Chan
description: Is a horror-comedy manga about Miko Yotsuya, a high school girl who suddenly develops the ability to see terrifying, grotesque spirits. Instead of screaming, Miko courageously chooses to ignore them to protect herself and her friends, leading to tense, humorous situations where she pretends the monsters aren't there.

name: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
description: Is a direct sequel manhwa following Sung Suho, the son of Sung Jinwoo, as he navigates a world besieged by new, cosmic threats known as the Itarim. After his father becomes an absolute god ruling the universe, Suho works to protect Earth by awakening his powers, battling monsters, and engaging in quests to stop these "outer gods" from invading.

name: Dinosaurs Sanctuary
description: Is a manga series by Kinoshita Itaru that follows Suma Suzume, a rookie zookeeper at Enoshima Dinoland, a struggling,, underfunded park. Unlike typical monster-focused stories, it realistically portrays dinosaurs as animals requiring specialized, often difficult care. name: Wind Breaker
description: Is an action-packed manga focusing on Haruka Sakura, a lonely, strong-willed delinquent who joins Furin High to fight his way to the top. Instead of mere fighting, he finds a town-protecting gang, the Bofurin, and must learn to trust others, evolving from an outcast into a heroic protector alongside his new allies.

name: Smoking behind the supermarket with you
description: Sasaki, an overworked salaryman, finds a release of his daily tensions in the customer service of Yamada, a winsome, cheery supermarket cashier. One day he finds himself working late, and, finding Yamada already done with work for the day, goes for a smoke, he finds a mysterious woman, "Tayama", who invites him to the smoking area behind the store.

name: Kenichi: The Mightiest Disciple 2: Masters Arc
description: Shirahama Kenichi, once an unremarkable high school student, has grown stronger under the guidance of the absurdly strong and beautiful girl Miu, spending his days training at Ryouzanpaku, where masters of various martial arts gather.

name: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
description: In a remote village, twins were born with a day-night separation. Yuru, the older twin, became an expert hunter, while Asa was burdened with a special duty, locked in a cage, and allowed to interact with only a few. One uneventful day, a group of armed men rode into the village on helicopters, called "dragons," seeking Yuru. They massacred everyone except Yuru. When he tries to save his sister, he discovers her lifeless body. Furthermore, the attacker claims to be Yuru's true twin sister. Just as he's about to be captured, a stranger named Dera intervenes and rescues him. However, they are soon trapped again. Dera advises Yuru to seek refuge in the village's deity by offering a present, which summons "tsugai," a duo whose mission is to uncover the truth behind the chaos.
